answer: Locks are recorded in basalt, expire in cipher, and opal lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 200 aliases therefore needs 89 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2887 identities would post 1311 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
